relationship.note: The daily financial workflow is a separate transaction population. The existing case-level comparator and its proposed workshare remain unchanged.

sources.title: Berkeley RFP 24-11661-C Addendum E
sources.edition_note: The issued cover identifies Addendum E despite the PDF metadata title. Its historic bid-date line contains a year inconsistency; this historical line creates no new procurement deadline for the proposed implementation workshare.

sources.title: City of Berkeley Permitting System Requirements and Procurement: To-Be Process Maps
sources.edition_note: The selected process sheets carry June 2024 dates. They describe proposed workflows and include legacy FUND$/Accela labels; they are not a current ledger export or proof of the deployed vendor configuration.

requirements.title: Daily receivables comparison
requirements.source_meaning: Compare daily receivables and permit transactions; investigate unmatched payments and denials.
requirements.product_behavior: Retain both selected source populations, exact native identifiers, requested/paid amounts, status interpretation, differences and review history. A case-level balance is not transaction evidence.

requirements.title: Configurable integration contract
requirements.source_meaning: Detailed exchange behavior is settled during implementation.
requirements.product_behavior: Version input/output layouts, identity rules, source-lane roles, amount encoding, timezone, report scope, status vocabulary and event semantics. Do not label a proposed layout as the vendor's native format.

requirements.title: Processor selection
requirements.source_meaning: ACI is identified; other compliant processors may be proposed.
requirements.product_behavior: Name the actual supplied processor and export edition. Reconciliation works from its retained reports without presuming an ACI API or replacing a processor.

requirements.title: Cashier session lifecycle
requirements.source_meaning: Open and close cashier sessions; prepare ERP exchange.
requirements.product_behavior: Bind a session to its cashier, day, tender population and original receipts. Keep prepared output, transmitted output and observed receivables separate.

requirements.title: Deposit review
requirements.source_meaning: Two authorized staff verify a deposit and its documents.
requirements.product_behavior: Retain two distinct reviewer identities against the exact prepared deposit edition, their entered observations and supporting artifacts. A later material change needs a new current review.

requirements.title: One-time payment meaning
requirements.source_meaning: POS denotes a one-time payment, not a POS system.
requirements.product_behavior: Allow department/division and original record references for these payments without requiring a fabricated permit or hardware device identity.

requirements.title: Partial allocation
requirements.source_meaning: Support partial payments and individual invoices.
requirements.product_behavior: Retain explicit allocations to invoice/fee identities, original amounts and unapplied remainder. Reject over-allocation and implicit cross-currency netting.

requirements.title: Financial change history
requirements.source_meaning: Retain fee/payment changes and responsible actors.
requirements.product_behavior: Corrections create new immutable editions or observed lifecycle entries. Preserve who changed which source interpretation, when, why and the exact prior record.

requirements.title: Daily reporting and over/short
requirements.source_meaning: Provide cashier, card and balancing reports with over/short.
requirements.product_behavior: Produce session, tender, department and date views from exact retained transactions; count supplied cash separately from expected cash. Unknown observations remain unknown.

requirements.title: Refund sequence
requirements.source_meaning: Refund approval, fee adjustment and the check request are distinct.
requirements.product_behavior: Model proposed correction, approval, actual fee/payment update, refund request and observed refund settlement separately. Every reversal links its original source transaction.

requirements.title: Returned payment sequence
requirements.source_meaning: Returned checks/chargebacks drive payment and workflow correction.
requirements.product_behavior: Retain the notification, returned amount, original payment, any separately supplied fee and resulting permit observation. An internal decision does not itself change the external permit.

requirements.title: Daily financial handoff
requirements.source_meaning: Reconcile daily reports and prepare reviewed deposit batches.
requirements.product_behavior: Retain complete source coverage, original unmatched rows, allocations, corrected captures, review decisions, selected close and transport/posting receipts in the handoff.

requirements.title: Preserve the existing permitting product
requirements.locator: Original comparison contract and Berkeley source recipes
requirements.source_meaning: Case-level paymentMinor and financial transactions use different contracts.
requirements.product_behavior: Read a selected existing case/ID crosswalk through an explicit edition binding when useful. Do not overwrite the original comparator, case findings, approved cutover or commercial scope.

proposed_configuration.meaning: System/instance/report family, lane, native identity fields and event-stream versus state-snapshot interpretation.
Accounting date/report interval, source timezone, department, cashier/session, merchant and settlement grouping; completeness declarations are source facts.
Exact decimal/minor-unit scale and currency; separate requested, paid, refund, fee and settlement/net fields when provided.
Source labels map explicitly to observed payment/denial/void/refund/return/adjustment meanings; no automatic amount inference from a label.
Native transaction, application/permit, invoice, fee, tender, original/reversal and batch references; optional reviewed many-to-many allocations.
Selected reports, accepted timing windows and explicit tolerances. Exact difference is the default; missing data is not zero.
Explicit partner-provided field order, encoding, separators, account codes and native row identity. If unsupplied, produce a labeled neutral handoff only.

acceptance.title: Original source and mapping
acceptance.result: All selected original bytes, native IDs, row positions, report scopes, mappings and interpretation versions can be reopened and exported. Reimporting the same source does not double count.

acceptance.title: Whole transaction population
acceptance.result: Every selected source row remains inspectable, including unmatched, invalid, rejected, voided, corrected and out-of-scope rows. Counts show what was imported and what participates.

acceptance.title: Exact allocation and totals
acceptance.result: The receiving operator can explain each payment allocation and remaining balance without floating-point changes, double reversals or cross-currency aggregation.

acceptance.title: Correction and source refresh
acceptance.result: A corrected report, mapping or allocation produces a new retained comparison; prior reviews stay tied to their original evidence and current review requirements update.

acceptance.title: Daily close
acceptance.result: A prepared close retains the exact included sources, transaction classifications, counts, tender observations, exceptions and distinct deposit reviewers; stale review cannot approve a later edition.

acceptance.title: Prepared versus actual exchange
acceptance.result: Output generation records its supplied layout and exact bytes. Transmission and receiving/posting observations are separate original receipts with uncertain results preserved.

acceptance.title: Portable continuation
acceptance.result: The full original source, configuration, allocations, lifecycle, daily packets and history reopen in a separate private receiving workspace without changing the original case.

uncertainties.detail: The selected issuer documents do not provide actual Clariti, Munis ERMA or ACI transaction columns, tenant account codes, unique-key rules or API credentials.
The exact accounting-day boundary, report completion signal, settlement delay and acceptable tolerance must be supplied for the selected implementation population.
An internal operator records supplied authority/review observations. The source does not make this tool a payment processor, agency ERP or identity provider.
Legacy FUND$/Accela labels and future Tyler Munis ERMA wording remain source-specific; they are not interchangeable schemas or a confirmed current deployment.
The existing $4,800 permitting workshare explicitly treats transaction-level reconciliation as a separate future delivery. This module does not alter the sent offer or claim a sale.
